text:
I know ulpan can seem super expensive, but honestly it was worth every shekel I spent on it. Getting the foundations, getting confident in them, and having a teacher to correct and guide made such a difference. I found it really hard to make things stick when learning alone. And honestly, most people I know don't have super great experiences with their partners being their Hebrew teacher - my case was no exception 😅 

There are some great videos on YouTube (Piece of Hebrew is awesome), and also some really unhelpful ones too (there are these listening tests from HebrewPod101 that have such unnatural intonations - it used to stress me out that I couldn't understand them, until my husband rightly said that literally no-one speaks like that). Otherwise, watching Disney movies in Hebrew can be fun - often the language is quite simple, we already know the plots, and the songs are catchy too :) 👸🏻
